column1: # 临时游戏档案（手工初建）| Provisional game profile (hand-made first cut)
# Ace Attorney Investigations Collection (逆转检察官 1&2 御剑精选集), Unity / IL2CPP, NVN
# Unity (IL2CPP): the NPDM declares system resource, so nninitStartup hands the application pool to StandardAllocator
# as virtual address memory. Values follow the Unity profile of this repository (Fire Emblem Engage), which measured
# 1.55 GB in use with a 2.5 GB pool: 5 GB block = 256 MB front + 4.375 GB alias + 256 MB stack + 128 MB heap.
# Unity's .NET/font engine uses nn::os::AllocateMemoryBlock, which needs the loader to have sized the heap (the game never
# calls SetHeapSize): hand out 1 GB at the first svc, like the real loader does. Other profiles leave this at 0.
# ---- NVN driver constant segments（先照 AA456 的基址，跑起来再看日志修正）----
# Unity/IL2CPP: shaders are compiled at build time and shipped as Shader objects inside UnityFS bundles; shader_split.py
# reads them through unityfs.py. Built-ins (Resources/, globalgamemanagers) go to engine, the Addressables bundles to assets.
# UnityPy (pip install UnityPy) reads the Shader objects of this game: its player strips type trees and patches the
# common string table, so unityfs cannot decode them. Run shader_split.py with DM_UNITYPY=1.
# Unity IL2CPP: .NET's own file API (System.IO) does not call nn::fs -- IL2CPP's PAL in main calls the SDK's libc stat,
# which the host does not hook, so File.Exists said "not found" for files that are in the RomFS and Addressables refused
# to start ("Invalid path in TextDataProvider ... settings.json"). The host now branches the two PAL byte-path stat
# entries (main+0x321f4c0 / +0x321f610) and their native bodies (main+0x3e4830 / +0x3e4a10) into hle_il2cpp.c, which
# answers from the same mount table as the nn::fs hooks. Keyed by the main build ID inside that file.
